def rotate_point_90_cw(r, c, height, width):
    """Rotate a point 90 degrees clockwise around the center"""
    # Center is at (height/2, width/2)
    cy, cx = height / 2, width / 2
    
    # Translate to origin
    dr, dc = r - cy, c - cx
    
    # Rotate 90 CW: (x, y) -> (-y, x)
    new_dr = -dc
    new_dc = dr
    
    # Translate back
    nr = cy + new_dr
    nc = cx + new_dc
    
    return int(nr), int(nc)
